Company.title: Company Profile
Company.description:
Goetvalve, which has been established for more than 20 years, is a professional company specializing in ultra-low temperature fluid control. Since its establishment, GOETVALVE has combined mechanical precision and innovative control technology seamlessly to design and develop multiple types of two-way valves that can withstand extremely low temperature media. 

In addition, most of the valve bodies from GOETVALVE are made from standard profiles.

In order to fulfill the environmental protection initiative, GOETVALVE has specially omitted the casting process with high energy consumption and high pollution. Although this will increase additional processing costs, it can greatly reduce the inventory of semi-finished products, and at the same time, it can meet the urgent needs of customers for delivery.

At present, GOETVALVE can provide various types of two-way solenoid valves, one-way valves, safety valves, filters, pneumatic on-off valves, and other products dedicated to cryogenic media. Meanwhile, we can also provide personalized customization of cryogenic valves, valve maintenance, engineering support, and other related services.

Our philosophy is: design and manufacture high-quality, highly reliable, and cost-effective products, and provide customers with practical solutions.

Product1.title: Solenoid Valves
Product1.description: Our cryogenic solenoid valves are designed to control low-temperature fluids safely and reliably. They are suitable for a wide range of applications, offering durability, precise operation, and high performance in extreme conditions. They can be supplied with a minimum temperature of -250°C and a maximum operating pressure of 100 bar. Available in standard and customizable versions, these valves provide efficient and cost-effective solutions for cryogenic systems, with options for different materials, connection types, and operating voltages to meet diverse customer needs.

Pressureactuated.title: Pressure Actuated Valve
Pressureactuated.description: Pneumatic piston valves are used to control and regulate extremely low-temperature cryogenic fluids. They can handle large flow rates and are suitable for high-viscosity or contaminated media. **We offer pressure-driven models only, specifically designed for cryogenic fluids, providing a minimum operating temperature of -250°C and a maximum operating pressure of 40 bar. Customization is available to meet specific application requirements.

liqnitrogen-non-return.title: Liquid nitrogen non-return valve
liqnitrogen-non-return.description: Our liquid nitrogen non-return valves are specially designed for ultra-low temperature media. They have a minimum opening pressure of 0.3 bar and a maximum withstand pressure of 30 bar, with a leakage rate of less than 0.01 cc in 10 minutes. The valves are made of stainless steel and are available in connection sizes from G1/4 to 1 inch, ensuring reliable performance in demanding cryogenic systems.

liqnitrofilter.title: Liquid nitrogen filter
liqnitrofilter.description: Our liquid nitrogen filters are specially designed for ultra-low temperature fluids, with selectable filtration precision ranging from 7 µm to 100 µm to ensure effective particle removal for sensitive applications. They can operate at temperatures as low as -200 °C and withstand a maximum working pressure of 30 bar. Connection sizes range from G1/4 to 1 inch. Robust, efficient, and customizable, these filters provide an ideal solution for demanding cryogenic systems.

safetyValve.title: Safety valves
safetyValve.description: Our safety valves are primarily designed for ultra-low temperature media, with a minimum operating temperature of -200 °C and selectable working pressure from 0 to 40 bar. Valve bodies are available in bronze or stainless steel, with connection sizes ranging from G3/8 to 1 inch, providing reliable protection and durability in demanding cryogenic applications.
